question: What was Julius Baer's CET1 ratio at the end of 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT value FROM figures WHERE bank='juliusbaer' AND year=2025 AND metric='cet1_ratio'

question: How many full-time employees did Vontobel have at the end of 2024?
reference_sql: SELECT value FROM figures WHERE bank='vontobel' AND year=2024 AND metric='headcount_fte'

question: Quel était le bénéfice net de la BCV en 2025 (en millions de CHF) ?
reference_sql: SELECT value FROM figures WHERE bank='bcv' AND year=2025 AND metric='net_profit'

question: What were EFG International's total assets at 31 December 2025, in CHF million?
reference_sql: SELECT value FROM figures WHERE bank='efg' AND year=2025 AND metric='total_assets'

question: What leverage ratio did Swissquote report for 2024?
reference_sql: SELECT value FROM figures WHERE bank='swissquote' AND year=2024 AND metric='leverage_ratio'

question: Quel était le ratio de fonds propres globaux de la BCGE fin 2025 ?
reference_sql: SELECT value FROM figures WHERE bank='bcge' AND year=2025 AND metric='total_capital_ratio'

question: What was Vontobel's return on equity in 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT value FROM figures WHERE bank='vontobel' AND year=2025 AND metric='return_on_equity'

question: How much net new money did Julius Baer attract in 2024, in CHF billion?
reference_sql: SELECT value FROM figures WHERE bank='juliusbaer' AND year=2024 AND metric='net_new_money'

question: What were Swissquote's operating expenses in 2025, in CHF million?
reference_sql: SELECT value FROM figures WHERE bank='swissquote' AND year=2025 AND metric='operating_expenses'

question: Give EFG's cost/income ratio for 2024.
reference_sql: SELECT value FROM figures WHERE bank='efg' AND year=2024 AND metric='cost_income_ratio'

question: Which three banks had the highest CET1 ratio in 2025? List them from highest to lowest.
reference_sql: SELECT bank FROM figures WHERE metric='cet1_ratio' AND year=2025 ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 3

question: Rank all banks by net profit in 2025, largest first, with the amount.
reference_sql: SELECT bank, value FROM figures WHERE metric='net_profit' AND year=2025 ORDER BY value DESC

question: Which bank had the lowest cost/income ratio in 2024?
reference_sql: SELECT bank FROM figures WHERE metric='cost_income_ratio' AND year=2024 ORDER BY value ASC LIMIT 1

question: Which bank employed the most people (FTE) at the end of 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT bank FROM figures WHERE metric='headcount_fte' AND year=2025 ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 1

question: Quelles sont les deux banques avec le ratio de levier le plus élevé en 2025 ?
reference_sql: SELECT bank FROM figures WHERE metric='leverage_ratio' AND year=2025 ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 2

question: Order the banks by total assets at the end of 2024, smallest first.
reference_sql: SELECT bank FROM figures WHERE metric='total_assets' AND year=2024 ORDER BY value ASC

question: Which bank had the highest return on equity in 2024, and what was it?
reference_sql: SELECT bank, value FROM figures WHERE metric='return_on_equity' AND year=2024 ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 1

question: Top 2 banks by operating income in 2025.
reference_sql: SELECT bank FROM figures WHERE metric='operating_income' AND year=2025 ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 2

question: What was the average CET1 ratio across all banks in 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT avg(value) FROM figures WHERE metric='cet1_ratio' AND year=2025

question: What was the combined net profit of the two French-language (cantonal) banks in 2025, in CHF million?
reference_sql: SELECT sum(f.value) FROM figures f JOIN documents d ON d.doc_id=f.doc_id WHERE d.lang='fr' AND f.metric='net_profit' AND f.year=2025

question: How many banks reported a CET1 ratio above 20% in 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM figures WHERE metric='cet1_ratio' AND year=2025 AND value > 20

question: What was the total headcount (FTE) of all six banks together at the end of 2024?
reference_sql: SELECT sum(value) FROM figures WHERE metric='headcount_fte' AND year=2024

question: Quel était le coefficient charges/produits moyen des banques anglophones en 2025 ?
reference_sql: SELECT avg(f.value) FROM figures f JOIN documents d ON d.doc_id=f.doc_id WHERE d.lang='en' AND f.metric='cost_income_ratio' AND f.year=2025

question: What was the highest and the lowest leverage ratio among the banks in 2024?
reference_sql: SELECT max(value), min(value) FROM figures WHERE metric='leverage_ratio' AND year=2024

question: For how many banks does the data include a net new money figure for 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM figures WHERE metric='net_new_money' AND year=2025

question: What was the average total capital ratio of each bank over 2024 and 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT bank, avg(value) FROM figures WHERE metric='total_capital_ratio' GROUP BY bank

question: Which banks increased their net profit from 2024 to 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT b.bank FROM figures a JOIN figures b ON a.bank=b.bank WHERE a.metric='net_profit' AND b.metric='net_profit' AND a.year=2024 AND b.year=2025 AND b.value > a.value

question: By how many CHF million did Julius Baer's net profit change from 2024 to 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT b.value - a.value FROM figures a JOIN figures b ON a.bank=b.bank WHERE a.bank='juliusbaer' AND a.metric='net_profit' AND b.metric='net_profit' AND a.year=2024 AND b.year=2025

question: Which banks grew their assets under management (client assets) between 2024 and 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT b.bank FROM figures a JOIN figures b ON a.bank=b.bank WHERE a.metric='assets_under_management' AND b.metric='assets_under_management' AND a.year=2024 AND b.year=2025 AND b.value > a.value

question: By how many percentage points did Vontobel's CET1 ratio change from 2024 to 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT b.value - a.value FROM figures a JOIN figures b ON a.bank=b.bank WHERE a.bank='vontobel' AND a.metric='cet1_ratio' AND b.metric='cet1_ratio' AND a.year=2024 AND b.year=2025

question: De combien de pour cent les charges d'exploitation de la BCGE ont-elles varié entre 2024 et 2025 ?
reference_sql: SELECT 100 * (b.value - a.value) / a.value FROM figures a JOIN figures b ON a.bank=b.bank WHERE a.bank='bcge' AND a.metric='operating_expenses' AND b.metric='operating_expenses' AND a.year=2024 AND b.year=2025

question: Which bank had the largest increase in headcount (FTE) from 2024 to 2025, and by how much?
reference_sql: SELECT b.bank, b.value - a.value FROM figures a JOIN figures b ON a.bank=b.bank WHERE a.metric='headcount_fte' AND b.metric='headcount_fte' AND a.year=2024 AND b.year=2025 ORDER BY b.value - a.value DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which banks saw their cost/income ratio improve (decrease) from 2024 to 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT b.bank FROM figures a JOIN figures b ON a.bank=b.bank WHERE a.metric='cost_income_ratio' AND b.metric='cost_income_ratio' AND a.year=2024 AND b.year=2025 AND b.value < a.value

question: What was the growth rate of Swissquote's operating income from 2024 to 2025, in percent?
reference_sql: SELECT 100 * (b.value - a.value) / a.value FROM figures a JOIN figures b ON a.bank=b.bank WHERE a.bank='swissquote' AND a.metric='operating_income' AND b.metric='operating_income' AND a.year=2024 AND b.year=2025

question: Which banks had a return on equity above 10% in 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT bank FROM figures WHERE metric='return_on_equity' AND year=2025 AND value > 10

question: Was Julius Baer's 2025 CET1 ratio higher than EFG's? Give both values.
reference_sql: SELECT bank, value FROM figures WHERE metric='cet1_ratio' AND year=2025 AND bank IN ('juliusbaer','efg')

question: Which banks had total assets above CHF 50 billion at the end of 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT bank FROM figures WHERE metric='total_assets' AND year=2025 AND value > 50000

question: Quelles banques avaient un ratio CET1 supérieur à celui de la BCV en 2025 ?
reference_sql: SELECT f.bank FROM figures f WHERE f.metric='cet1_ratio' AND f.year=2025 AND f.value > (SELECT value FROM figures WHERE bank='bcv' AND metric='cet1_ratio' AND year=2025)

question: What is the difference between the highest and lowest net profit among the banks in 2024, in CHF million?
reference_sql: SELECT max(value) - min(value) FROM figures WHERE metric='net_profit' AND year=2024

question: For 2025, list each bank's net profit per full-time employee in CHF thousand.
reference_sql: SELECT p.bank, 1000 * p.value / h.value FROM figures p JOIN figures h ON p.bank=h.bank AND p.year=h.year WHERE p.metric='net_profit' AND h.metric='headcount_fte' AND p.year=2025
